- As of 7 October 2026, Russia reports a possible pneumonic plague outbreak in Irkutsk Oblast. China issued its first official response, stressing continued Sino–Russian cooperation on infectious disease prevention and noting joint drills with the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute and cross-border monitoring discussions; Irkutsk remains a transport hub linking to China by air and rail.
